title: formvfx

toolchain.linux_packages: libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf gstreamer1.0-plugins-base gstreamer1.0-plugins-good

build.windows:
call formvfx.bat install
call formvfx.bat install-desktop
call formvfx.bat desktop build %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG%

catalog.name: FormVFX
catalog.summary: Motion graphics and visual effects on a layered timeline.

notes_for_owner: Build mode is commands, not contract: ./formvfx desktop build runs ./build_app, which refuses --config (usage, exit 2), builds only --bundles app on macOS and deb on Linux, so the old workflow's `./formvfx desktop build --config ...` could not have produced the full bundle set. macOS and Linux call setup/desktop_build (plain tauri build, passes --config through); Windows calls formvfx.bat desktop build %FORMCOMPILER_CONFIG_ARG%, which since formvfx 0.52.4 runs setup\desktop_build.bat (frontend, freeze, tauri build w/ the arguments) w/o installing again, so Windows builds make updater artifacts too. Expect AppImage, rpm and the macOS updater archive on a release now, which the old path did not build. The updater public key in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json is still empty, so the app skips update checks until a key pair is made and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY is set in formcompiler.
